structure.unit: Institutions of Higher Education; Other Educational and Cultural Institutions
State Council of Higher Education for Virginia
Regulation of Certain Private and Out-Of-State Institutions of Higher Education

law.catch_line: Laws of the Commonwealth to apply to contracts
law.text: The laws of the Commonwealth shall govern any agreement, contract, or instrument of indebtedness executed between a postsecondary school and any person who enrolls in any course or program offered or to be offered by such school in the Commonwealth or any person who is employed or offered employment by such school in the Commonwealth.
